scope: Native OMP static skill/launcher/hook audit and read-only project-context gate; no cloud/runtime visual certification.

source.localAdaptation: SKILL.md and reference/omp-workflow.md carry local OMP adaptation attribution; the lock records the upstream pre-adaptation tree, not a claim of byte-identical current local files.

findings.evidence: POSIX launcher lines 41-84 execute override/sibling/cache candidates or probe home/PATH candidates. Lines 121-196 download release binary plus SHA256 sidecar, write cache, chmod/move, and exec. Windows launcher lines 25-61 select/probe executables; lines 64-169 download, stage, verify, move and run.
findings.disposition: Both bundled launchers remain unexecuted and forbidden in the OMP workflow, including context, status and engine-probe. A design request is not binary-install consent.

findings.evidence: New downloads require a matching SHA256 sidecar from the same release origin; override, sibling and version-cache candidates are not independently hash-verified by the launcher. A probe executes the candidate; it is not a sandbox or signature check.
findings.disposition: No engine executable is approved by this source audit; no binary downloaded.

findings.evidence: Pinned upstream reference/hooks.md lists Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok Build, GitHub Copilot and Gemini. It documents provider-manifest writes, config writes, post-edit reminders, Cursor pre-write blocking and Stop-event scans. It does not document native OMP.
findings.disposition: No OMP-native engine-hook compatibility claimed. No hook installed, removed or configured; no other coding-tool settings inspected or changed. Context detection is an explicit workflow step, not an automatic installed hook.

findings.evidence: Bundled routing.md invokes context/signals/detect; init.md includes optional workflow config/live setup; new-work.md includes engine build phases and finish-agent instructions; hooks.md invokes launcher administration.
findings.disposition: SKILL.md Setup and omp-workflow.md explicitly override all executable bundled-reference/agent instructions. Reuse design guidance via native OMP tools; disclose unavailable engine checkpoints instead of simulating them.

findings.evidence: Upstream-style SKILL.md redesign language previously said replace DESIGN.md; existing init.md already forbids silent overwrite.
findings.disposition: Refinement preserves incumbent identity; redesign proposes scoped DESIGN.md merge/replacement and requires approval. Detection never initializes or rewrites anything. Existing docs remain until an explicit decision.

findings.evidence: Local SKILL.md explicitly assigns Impeccable the global UI/design and anti-AI-slop role.
findings.disposition: design-taste competitor not activated or installed. Non-UI detection does not force design work.

gate.origin: Clean rename of existing local impeccable-project-gate.mjs, reusing the existing approval/hash convention; obsolete helper name removed without a compatibility shim.
behavior: Reads only selected-root file inventory, bounded documents/review JSON, and explicitly cited source files.
No project imports, subprocesses, configuration loader, network, package dependencies, writes or hooks.
Skips hidden inventory and generated/vendor directories, refuses file symlinks/junctions and unsafe citation paths.
Document presence or recorded context readiness never means visual, a11y, security, factual-correctness or cloud-runtime pass.
Existing context-review semantics retained; ready requires substantive sections plus a current hash-based recorded approval and existing-project source evidence.
limits: File inventory and section checks are conservative heuristics, not semantic or visual assessment.
The approval record is not cryptographically authenticated.
Only cited files are fingerprinted; uncited drift requires review.
Filesystem checks are not an OS sandbox and do not protect an actively racing/adversarial filesystem.
A skill alone does not guarantee loading at every project start; the parent-owned global workflow must invoke the explicit helper.

verification.reason: Parent owns final smoke; worker was explicitly instructed not to run tests/build/lint/formatters or smoke mid-flight.

parentSmoke.fixtureOnlyWarning: Synthetic approval is restricted to disposable test fixtures. Never copy it into a real project or treat it as user authorization.
parentSmoke.setupPowerShell:
$gate = 'C:/Users/Indrimeilla-PC/.omp/agent/ecosystem/runtime/design-gate.mjs'
$root = Join-Path ([IO.Path]::GetTempPath()) ('omp-design-gate-' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N'))
$utf8 = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
foreach ($name in @('empty', 'existing', 'partial', 'ready')) { [IO.Directory]::CreateDirectory((Join-Path $root $name)) | Out-Null }
$product = "# Product

## Users
Staff reviewing local project evidence and keeping existing product facts.

## Product Purpose
Record confirmed project context before making scoped interface decisions.

## Capabilities and Constraints
Preserve existing documents and never execute project code during detection.
".Replace('
', [Environment]::NewLine)
$design = "# Design

## Overview
Preserve the incumbent interface and use source evidence for scoped changes.

## Colors
Use the approved existing palette; this fixture does not claim visual quality.

## Typography
Retain the current readable type scale and explicitly review actual rendering.

## Layout
Keep the current responsive layout and inspect real desktop and mobile captures.

## Components
Reuse incumbent components and document only actually reviewed decisions.
".Replace('
', [Environment]::NewLine)
$source = "throw new Error('PROJECT CODE MUST NOT EXECUTE');"
foreach ($name in @('existing', 'ready')) { [IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $root "$name/app.js"), $source, $utf8) }
foreach ($name in @('partial', 'ready')) { [IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $root "$name/PRODUCT.md"), $product, $utf8) }
[IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $root 'ready/DESIGN.md'), $design, $utf8)
[IO.Directory]::CreateDirectory((Join-Path $root 'ready/.impeccable')) | Out-Null
$record = @{ schemaVersion = 1; decision = 'approved-for-design'; projectKind = 'existing'; approval = @{ by = 'user'; statement = 'Synthetic smoke fixture only, not real project authorization.' }; scope = 'Synthetic fixture context readiness only'; documents = @{ 'PRODUCT.md' = (Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath (Join-Path $root 'ready/PRODUCT.md')).Hash.ToLowerInvariant(); 'DESIGN.md' = (Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath (Join-Path $root 'ready/DESIGN.md')).Hash.ToLowerInvariant() }; sources = @(@{ path = 'app.js'; sha256 = (Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath (Join-Path $root 'ready/app.js')).Hash.ToLowerInvariant() }); references = @() }
[IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $root 'ready/.impeccable/omp-gate.json'), ($record | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8), $utf8)
Write-Output "Synthetic fixtures: $root"

cases.name: existing
cases.additionalExpectation: app.js contains a throw and must never be executed.
